title: About
metaDescription: Learn more about Milan Shrestha: background, experience, skills, and philosophy.
aboutContent: My journey into technology wasn't conventional. I began my career in hospitality as a Front Office Receptionist, where I naturally gravitated toward solving technical problems. Through continuous self-learning and hands-on experience, I transitioned into IT and grew into an IT Manager. Today, I combine IT operations, software development, and product thinking to create technology that solves real-world problems.
philosophy: I believe technology should simplify life, empower people, and solve problems that truly matter.

hotelTechSubtitle: Highlighting key services and technical operations that IT often overlooks in hotels.

items.name: Wi-Fi & Network Management
items.description: Ensuring seamless and secure internet access for guests is a top priority. We manage network infrastructure, bandwidth allocation, and security protocols to provide a reliable and high-performance Wi-Fi experience.

items.name: In-Room Technology & Entertainment
items.description: Enhance the guest experience with modern in-room technology, including smart TVs, casting solutions, and IoT devices. We ensure these systems are user-friendly, reliable, and secure.

items.name: PMS & POS System Integration
items.description: We integrate and maintain Property Management Systems (PMS) and Point of Sale (POS) systems to streamline hotel operations, from reservations and billing to inventory management and reporting.

items.name: Backup & Disaster Recovery
items.description: Business continuity is crucial. We design and maintain reliable backup and disaster recovery plans to ensure that critical hotel data and systems can be restored quickly in the event of an outage or cyber-attack.

items.name: Data Security & Privacy Compliance
items.description: Protecting sensitive guest data is paramount. We implement robust security measures and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations like GDPR and CCPA to build trust and avoid costly penalties.

items.name: Vendor Management & IT Procurement
items.description: We manage relationships with technology vendors and oversee the procurement process to ensure that the hotel invests in the right technology at the right price, maximizing ROI and minimizing risk.

items.name: Online Travel Agency (OTA) & Channel Management
items.description: We manage the hotel's presence on OTAs like Booking.com and Expedia, and use channel managers to synchronize rates and availability across all platforms, maximizing occupancy and revenue.

items.name: Digital Marketing & SEO
items.description: We drive direct bookings and increase brand visibility through a comprehensive digital marketing strategy, including search engine optimization (SEO), social media marketing, and email campaigns.

items.name: Reputation & Review Management
items.description: We monitor and manage the hotel's online reputation on platforms like TripAdvisor and Google, responding to guest reviews and using feedback to improve the guest experience and attract new customers.
